name: @nexus-js/chrome
description: Chrome extension adapter for Nexus framework
author: Carson Yu

scripts.build:test-extension: pnpm --filter @nexus-js/core build && pnpm --filter @nexus-js/chrome build && rm -rf tests/browser/extension/.output tests/browser/extension/.wxt && pnpm exec wxt build tests/browser/extension --browser chrome && if [ -f tests/browser/build-extension.ts ]; then tsx tests/browser/build-extension.ts; fi
scripts.typecheck:browser: pnpm run prepare:test-extension && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/browser/extension/tsconfig.json
scripts.ensure:test-extension: pnpm run prepare:test-extension && pnpm run build:test-extension && pnpm run typecheck:browser
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run ensure:test-extension && playwright test --project=foundation-normal && playwright test --project=normal
scripts.test:browser:worker:p0: pnpm run ensure:test-extension && playwright test --project=worker-gate && playwright test --project=worker-p0
scripts.test:browser:worker: pnpm run ensure:test-extension && playwright test --project=worker-gate && playwright test --project=worker
scripts.test:browser:scaffold: pnpm run test:browser:scaffold:unit && pnpm run ensure:test-extension && playwright test --project=foundation-normal && playwright test --project=worker-gate
